lines.en: I slide along the silt.
My long saw sweeps ahead of me.
I slowly settle into the sand.
I shift inch by inch along the bottom.
My tail kicks up the sand.
I swim toward the shallows.
I weave along the edge of the weeds.
I lift half out of the sand.
I ride the current downward.
My saw sweeps an arc as I turn.
I press closer to the riverbed.
I travel on, saw trailing.
I cross above a gap in the stones.
I am looking for a spot in the silt.
I lift slightly and settle.
I shift along with the tremors in the riverbed.
I lie buried with only my eyes out.
My long saw lies across the bottom.
I hold still, waiting for a step.
Sand covers most of me.
My tail sways gently.

lines.zh: 我几乎和水底一个颜色。
lines.en: I am nearly the color of the riverbed.

lines.zh: 沙盖住我，只剩锯尖露着。
lines.en: Sand covers me but for the tip of my saw.
I raise the saw a little.
I lie low for a long while.
I wait for the water to warm.
My mouth works against the bottom.
I flatten myself further.
My gills move slowly.
I turn half a circle in the sand.
I lift my eyes from the sand.
My saw points at your feet.
You are at the water's edge, quite safe.
I am watching where you step.
I raise my back slowly.
My saw glints in the light.

lines.zh: 我歪了一下头，又沉下去。
lines.en: I tilt my head and sink again.
I hold still, and so does the saw.
You have stepped into the shallows.
My eyes stay turned upward.
I bolt upward.
I churn the sand into a cloud.
I retreat with the saw dragging.
Sand settles on me.
I make no sound at all.
I dig into the sand again.
My saw hangs crooked.
I slowly set myself right.
I press to the bottom and hold.
I sink another half inch into the sand.
I rise from the sand to sniff.
I slide a circle around it.
My saw pushes it aside.
I bite and spit it out.
I favor things that move.
I press it under the sand.
I look a long while before moving.
I drag it down with me.

lines.zh: 我绕着那块肉转了半圈。
lines.en: I circle the meat half a turn.
It falls apart in my mouth.
You step on me and I lurch.
Sand billows up and blocks the view.
My saw catches your leg.
I slide half a block and rebury.
We muddy the bottom.
I bolt out from under your feet.
The saw rakes you.

lines.zh: 我的身体很扁，贴在地上。
lines.en: I am flat against the ground.
You cannot move me at all.
I slowly bury myself again.
Two long saws run parallel on the bottom.
Our saws touch.
We settle into the sand together.
It stops along my flank.
Two long saws lie side by side on the bottom.
We lift a little together.

lines.zh: 它们之间几乎没有声音。
lines.en: There is almost no sound between them.
We slide deeper together.

lines.zh: 它们的影子在沙上重叠。
lines.en: Their shadows overlap on the sand.
Neither of us raises a saw.
My saw flicks it up.
I take it in my jaws.
I press it under the sand.
It hangs on the saw's teeth.
I slide a ways with it.
I let go and it drifts off.
I throw it behind me.
I glance and put it down.

lines.zh: 我用吻把它顶到石缝里。
lines.en: I push it into a stone gap with my snout.
I dig it out of the sand.

lines.zh: 我把长锯从沙里抽出来。
lines.en: I pull my long saw out of the sand.

lines.zh: 有东西踩上了我头上的沙。
lines.en: Something stepped on the sand above me.

lines.zh: 我把长锯对准你的方向。
lines.en: I aim my long saw toward you.
My saw comes up.
I begin heading your way.
I am no longer buried.
I have chosen this line.
I know your position.
I press toward the shallows.
My body straightens.
I am preparing one sweep.
I stay aimed at your feet.
I follow along the bottom.
You wade; I follow beneath.
I stay on the bottom.
I shift my angle little by little.
You enter deeper water and I speed up.
My saw lies inside your shadow.

lines.zh: 你每走一步，我埋得更深。
lines.en: Each step you take, I bury myself deeper.
I come around the weeds.
You are behind a stone; I wait.
I am one block from your foot.
The bottom sand rolls once.
I move to a new hiding spot.
I come around in front of you from below.

lines.zh: 我的锯横着扫过你的腿。
lines.en: My saw sweeps across your legs.
I burst from the sand into you.

lines.zh: 我的锯齿划开你的裤脚。
lines.en: The saw's teeth slice your trousers.
I whip my head and the saw slaps you.
You are swept into the water.
After the hit I sink back into the sand.

lines.zh: 我的锯在你脚踝边停下。
lines.en: My saw stops by your ankle.
You jump clear; the saw hits stone.
I come up from the other side.

lines.zh: 我用长锯横扫你的膝盖。
lines.en: I sweep my long saw across your knees.
You are dragged to one knee in the water.
The saw passes again.
The riverbed bulges in one spot.
Something moves under the sand.
I slowly emerge from the sand.
Fine ripples spread on the surface.
A long shadow has appeared here.

lines.zh: 你听见沙被拨开的声音。
lines.en: You hear sand being pushed aside.
I begin patrolling the shallows.
My saw shows above the sand first.
I begin lying in wait here.
The sand settles flat again.
A long bulge rises in the sand.
The water parts under your feet.
Silt slowly spreads in the water.
I have buried myself.

lines.zh: 水护着我，只有锯尖烫了。
lines.en: The water shields me; only the saw's tip burns.

lines.zh: 我被抛上沙岸，重重落下。
lines.en: I am thrown onto the sand and land hard.

lines.zh: 我忽然吸不到水，很难受。
lines.en: I suddenly cannot draw water and it hurts.

lines.zh: 水下炸开，把我从沙里掀出来。
lines.en: The blast bursts and throws me out of the sand.
An arrow pierces my fin.

lines.zh: 那股力量钉住了我的身体。
lines.en: That force nails my body down.
Hunger makes even my burying unsteady.

lines.zh: 雷打进浅水，我浑身一抽。
lines.en: Lightning hits the shallows and I convulse.

lines.zh: 下面的水没了，我落下去。
lines.en: The water below is gone; I drop.
